text:
You need a basic WordPress site cleaned up, modernized, sped up, and refocused from cart functionality into a simple, SEO-friendly company and process showcase that you can still update yourself.

I’m Tobias Reyne, with 7 years of experience in full stack web development. I recently rebuilt a slow theme-based shop for Juniper & Ash Home into a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves, using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Sanity, and Vercel. That work improved largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months.

For primaclones.com, I’d keep the structure simple, remove the shopping cart, improve performance, and organize the site around your company, processes, and work. I’d also make sure the content setup stays easy for you to manage and optimized for SEO.
